touristGuide.title: Uptown Charlotte & The Queen City
touristGuide.text: Named after Queen Charlotte, this bustling financial hub blends glass skyscrapers with leafy greenways. Just outside the city, North Carolina stretches from the misty Blue Ridge Mountains to the sandy Outer Banks.

hotspots.translation: centro financeiro (termo usado em Charlotte em vez de downtown)
hotspots.example: In Charlotte, locals call the city center Uptown rather than downtown.

hotspots.translation: carne de porco desfiada e defumada
hotspots.example: North Carolina is famous for pulled pork with tangy vinegar sauce.

hotspots.translation: lema das placas de carro da Carolina do Norte
hotspots.example: The Wright brothers' first powered flight took place in North Carolina.

mission.title: Choose a Carolina Barbecue Sauce
mission.description: Você está em uma churrascaria da Carolina do Norte escolhendo o molho do pulled pork.

steps.npcLine: Would you like Eastern vinegar sauce or Lexington-style tomato sauce with your pulled pork?

options.text: Let's go with the vinegar sauce. Could I get coleslaw on the side?
options.feedback: Excelente! 'On the side' é a expressão natural para pedir acompanhamentos separados.

options.text: Put the acid sauce and cabbage salad separated in the plate.
options.feedback: A salada de repolho é 'coleslaw', e para pedir algo separado do prato diga 'on the side'.

touristGuide.title: Historic Richmond & The James River
touristGuide.text: Set along the James River, Richmond is rich in American history, brick-lined neighborhoods, and independent shops. Carytown is a favorite local district for browsing and dining.

hotspots.translation: comunidade; designação oficial usada por Virginia
hotspots.example: Virginia is officially known as a Commonwealth.

hotspots.translation: casa geminada de vários andares
hotspots.example: Historic red-brick townhouses line the streets of Richmond's Fan District.

hotspots.translation: estrada com pedágio
hotspots.example: Check whether your rental car includes an E-ZPass for the toll road.

mission.title: Ask About a Toll Pass
mission.description: Você está alugando um carro em Richmond e quer entender a cobrança do passe de pedágio.

steps.npcLine: If you're taking I-95 North, you'll reach express toll lanes. Would you like to add our toll pass?

options.text: How much is the daily fee, and does the pass cover the express lanes?
options.feedback: Boa! Perguntar pela 'daily fee' e o que ela cobre ajuda a evitar cobranças inesperadas.

options.text: How much money to pay the road taxes every day?
options.feedback: Pedágio é 'toll'. Para perguntar o preço, use 'How much is the daily fee?'

touristGuide.title: Cleveland & The Rock and Roll Hall of Fame
touristGuide.text: On the southern shore of Lake Erie, Cleveland is home to the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame, lively theater districts, and passionate sports fans.

hotspots.translation: orla do lago
hotspots.example: Breezes off Lake Erie keep the Cleveland lakefront cool in late spring.

hotspots.translation: apelido de um morador de Ohio; também nome de um doce local
hotspots.example: We brought homemade Buckeye candies to the game.

hotspots.translation: confraternização no estacionamento antes de um jogo
hotspots.example: Fans grilled burgers in the parking lot during a tailgate before kickoff.

mission.title: Get Tickets to the Rock Hall
mission.description: Você chegou à bilheteria do Rock & Roll Hall of Fame e quer comprar ingressos.

steps.npcLine: General admission gets you into all six floors. How many tickets do you need?

options.text: Two adult tickets, please. Is photography allowed inside?
options.feedback: Perfeito! 'Ticket' significa ingresso, e 'Is photography allowed?' pergunta naturalmente sobre fotos.

options.text: I want two entrances for adults. Can I take pictures with my telephone?
options.feedback: Ingresso é 'ticket' ou 'admission'; 'entrance' é a entrada física. Para celular, prefira 'phone'.

touristGuide.title: Baltimore's Historic Inner Harbor
touristGuide.text: Baltimore's Inner Harbor combines waterfront walks, historic ships, and museums. Local menus feature Chesapeake Bay seafood, especially blue crab and crab cakes.

hotspots.translation: caranguejo-azul da baía de Chesapeake
hotspots.example: The blue crab is closely associated with the Chesapeake Bay.

hotspots.translation: mistura de temperos muito usada em frutos do mar na região
hotspots.example: They sprinkled Old Bay over the steamed crabs.

hotspots.translation: barco usado como transporte entre pontos da orla
hotspots.example: We took the water taxi across the harbor after visiting the museum.

mission.title: Order a Crab Cake
mission.description: Em um restaurante da orla de Baltimore, pergunte como o crab cake é preparado.

steps.npcLine: Our crab cakes are made with jumbo lump crab and served with Old Bay fries.

options.text: That sounds great. Is the crab cake broiled or fried?
options.feedback: Muito bem! 'Is it broiled or fried?' pergunta se o prato é grelhado no forno ou frito.

options.text: How you cook this crab cake?
options.feedback: Para perguntar o método de preparo, diga 'How is it cooked?' ou 'Is it broiled or fried?'

route3D.name: Downtown Anchorage to the Coastal Trail

touristGuide.title: Anchorage Coastal Trail
touristGuide.text: Anchorage pairs a lively downtown with mountain views and access to the Tony Knowles Coastal Trail. On clear days, the path offers broad views of Cook Inlet and the surrounding landscape.

hotspots.translation: sol da meia-noite, fenômeno de dias muito longos no verão
hotspots.example: The midnight sun gives Anchorage long summer evenings.

hotspots.translation: geleira
hotspots.example: We booked a boat tour to see a glacier in the bay.

hotspots.translation: região onde vivem ursos selvagens
hotspots.example: This trail is bear country, so follow the posted safety guidance.

mission.title: Ask About the Coastal Trail
mission.description: Você quer caminhar pela trilha costeira e confirmar onde ela começa e quanto tempo leva.

steps.npcLine: The Coastal Trail is a great walk this afternoon. Are you heading out now?

options.text: Yes. Where is the nearest trail entrance, and how long is the walk to the viewpoint?
options.feedback: Ótimo! Você perguntou onde fica a entrada e quanto tempo leva até o mirante, duas informações úteis para planejar a caminhada.

options.text: Yes, where the trail starts and how many time to the view?
options.feedback: Use 'Where does the trail start?' e 'How long does it take to get to the viewpoint?'

route3D.name: Santa Fe Plaza and Canyon Road

touristGuide.title: Santa Fe Plaza
touristGuide.text: Santa Fe's central plaza is surrounded by adobe architecture, galleries, and shops. The city's food reflects a blend of Native American, Hispanic, and Southwestern traditions.

hotspots.translation: adobe, material de construção de terra e palha
hotspots.example: The adobe buildings give the plaza its distinctive warm colors.

hotspots.translation: pergunta tradicional sobre o tipo de chile desejado
hotspots.example: When you order enchiladas in New Mexico, the server may ask, 'Red or green?'

hotspots.translation: pedido com chile vermelho e verde juntos
hotspots.example: I'll have my breakfast burrito Christmas, with both red and green chile.

mission.title: Choose Your Chile
mission.description: Em um restaurante de Santa Fe, o atendente pergunta se você prefere chile vermelho, verde ou os dois.

steps.npcLine: Would you like red or green chile with your enchiladas?

options.text: Christmas, please. I'd like both red and green chile.
options.feedback: Perfeito! Em New Mexico, pedir 'Christmas' significa escolher os dois tipos de chile.

options.text: I want the Christmas sauce because today is December.
options.feedback: Aqui 'Christmas' não indica a data: é o pedido de chile vermelho e verde juntos.

touristGuide.title: Charleston Historic District
touristGuide.text: Charleston's historic district is known for pastel houses, shaded streets, and a working waterfront. The city's Lowcountry cuisine often features seafood, rice, and local ingredients.

hotspots.translation: região costeira baixa do sudeste da Carolina do Sul e da Geórgia
hotspots.example: Lowcountry cooking often includes seafood and locally grown rice.

hotspots.translation: camarão servido com creme de milho
hotspots.example: The cafe serves shrimp and grits with a savory sauce.

hotspots.translation: cesta artesanal feita de capim-doce
hotspots.example: We watched a local artist weave a sweetgrass basket at the market.

mission.title: Find a Harbor Tour
mission.description: Você está perto do porto de Charleston e quer saber se ainda há vagas para um passeio de barco.

steps.npcLine: The harbor tour leaves in about twenty minutes. How many people are in your group?

options.text: There are two of us. Do you still have seats available?
options.feedback: Muito bem! 'There are two of us' informa o tamanho do grupo, e 'seats available' pergunta se há lugares disponíveis.

options.text: We are in two. Has places in the boat?
options.feedback: Para dizer que são duas pessoas, use 'There are two of us'. Pergunte 'Do you have seats available?'

touristGuide.title: Gateway Arch National Park
touristGuide.text: The stainless-steel Gateway Arch rises above the Mississippi River and the St. Louis riverfront. The nearby museum explores the region's role in westward expansion.

hotspots.translation: ravioli empanado e frito, especialidade de St. Louis
hotspots.example: We shared toasted ravioli as an appetizer before the game.

hotspots.translation: apelido informal de St. Louis
hotspots.example: My cousin grew up in the Lou and still cheers for the home team.

hotspots.translation: sistema de trem leve da região de St. Louis
hotspots.example: You can take MetroLink from downtown to the airport.

mission.title: Take MetroLink to the Airport
mission.description: Você quer chegar ao aeroporto usando o trem leve e precisa confirmar a direção.

steps.npcLine: Are you heading to the airport on MetroLink?

options.text: Yes. Is this the train going toward Lambert Airport?
options.feedback: Boa! 'Is this the train going toward...?' confirma se o trem segue na direção desejada.

options.text: Yes. This train goes for the airport?
options.feedback: Use a estrutura de pergunta 'Does this train go to the airport?' ou 'Is this the train going toward...?'

touristGuide.title: Louisville's Whiskey Row
touristGuide.text: Louisville's historic Whiskey Row is lined with restored buildings that recall the city's bourbon trade. The city is also famous for the Kentucky Derby and its signature Hot Brown sandwich.

hotspots.translation: roteiro de destilarias de bourbon no Kentucky
hotspots.example: We planned a day trip to visit two stops on the Bourbon Trail.

hotspots.translation: a corrida Kentucky Derby, realizada em Louisville
hotspots.example: The city gets especially busy during Derby week.

hotspots.translation: sanduíche quente aberto com peru, molho e queijo
hotspots.example: I ordered a Hot Brown, a Louisville specialty with turkey and cheese sauce.

mission.title: Order a Louisville Hot Brown
mission.description: Você está em um restaurante de Louisville e quer saber se o Hot Brown serve uma ou duas pessoas.

steps.npcLine: Our Hot Brown is an open-faced turkey sandwich with Mornay sauce. Would you like one?

options.text: That sounds good. Is one serving large enough to share?
options.feedback: Excelente! 'Large enough to share' pergunta se a porção é grande o bastante para dividir.

options.text: One is enough big for divide?
options.feedback: Use 'Is one serving large enough to share?' para perguntar naturalmente se dá para dividir.

touristGuide.title: Milwaukee RiverWalk
touristGuide.text: Milwaukee's RiverWalk connects downtown neighborhoods with public art, restaurants, and views of the river. The city is known for its brewing history, neighborhood festivals, and Friday fish fries.

hotspots.translation: pedaços jovens de queijo, muitas vezes empanados e fritos
hotspots.example: We ordered fried cheese curds to share at the brewery.

hotspots.translation: jantar tradicional de peixe servido às sextas-feiras
hotspots.example: The neighborhood tavern is packed for its Friday fish fry.

hotspots.translation: visita guiada a uma cervejaria
hotspots.example: We booked a brewery tour to learn about Milwaukee's brewing history.

mission.title: Find a Friday Fish Fry
mission.description: Você quer experimentar o jantar tradicional de peixe e pergunta se precisa reservar.

steps.npcLine: The Friday fish fry is popular here. Are you planning to stop by tonight?

options.text: Yes. Do we need a reservation, or can we just walk in?
options.feedback: Muito bem! 'Can we just walk in?' pergunta se vocês podem chegar sem reserva.

options.text: Yes. We need make a reserve or enter walking?
options.feedback: Reserva é 'reservation'. Para perguntar se pode chegar sem marcar, diga 'Can we just walk in?'
